critical_code_review_comments: FIXED during test: orchestrator.get_settings() returned the raw Mongo doc including ObjectId _id, causing GET /api/orchestrator/settings → 500. Wrapped return in models.clean() so _id is stripped. (Same pattern recurs across the codebase — anywhere a router directly returns db.find_one(...) without clean(), a 500 will trigger. Consider a small utility/decorator or lint rule.)
orchestrator.py imports models.clean lazily inside get_settings; consider moving the import to the top of the module for consistency.
TopicRegistry.js sends `count` as Number(count), server clamps to [10,120]. Anything <10 silently becomes 10; front-end min=10 already, but showing the clamp in UI would prevent surprise.

product_protection.create_secure_link stores expires_at as ISO string and compares with datetime.now().isoformat() — lexicographic ISO comparison works only for tz-aware UTC strings with identical formatting. Currently both use `.isoformat()` so it's safe, but a naive/aware mismatch would silently fail; consider parsing with fromisoformat().

download endpoint (/api/protection/download/{token}) is unauthenticated by design (public expiring link). Anti-sharing relies solely on max_access=5 and expires_at. Consider optional IP/UA fingerprint check for tighter anti-share.
Verification /log endpoint scans all knowledge_records and flattens verification_log in-process (up to 300 docs). Fine at current scale; add a persistent verification_log collection if this grows.
auth.change_password validates new password but does NOT prevent setting the same as current; acceptable but noted.

misc.py delete_user does not clear owner_id from records owned by the deleted user; may leave orphaned owner_id references. Not exercised here (Founder is undeletable), but worth noting for demo/admin cleanup flows.

Fix applied: orchestrator.get_settings() now runs docs through clean(); this pattern (raw Mongo doc → 500 on ObjectId) may recur elsewhere.
rca of the issue: GET /api/orchestrator/settings returned 500 because orchestrator.get_settings() returned the raw MongoDB document (including bson.ObjectId _id) directly. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId → 'ObjectId object is not iterable' → ValueError → 500. Reproduction: hit GET /api/orchestrator/settings with a valid Founder Bearer token. Mitigation applied: wrap the return in models.clean(), which strips _id and coerces the doc into JSON-safe dict. Confirmed 200 with body {"id":"factory","hands_free_mode":true} after fix.
